readmeHtml:
Video tools for the agent era.

Video Creation

  • Make videos agentically: Turn your idea into a video using your coding agent.
  • Make videos interactively: Edit and animate using drag and drop.
  • Make videos programmatically: Connect to data, and manage complexity with code.

React Code is the source of truth. Switch your workflow at any point.

Video Automation

  • Design systems: Create a library of animated assets for your organization.
  • Batch rendering: Render millions of videos on your own infrastructure.
  • Applications: Publish a simple tool or a complex video editor.

Get started

If you already have Node.JS installed, type

npx create-video@latest

to get started. Otherwise, read the installation page in the documentation.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A framework for creating videos programmatically using React.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Remotion allows developers to create videos by writing React code. It treats video creation as a software engineering task, enabling version control, programmatic generation, and dynamic data binding. You can create complex animations, connect to external APIs, and render videos either via CLI or dynamically in cloud environments. It is ideal for generating personalized videos at scale or building sophisticated video editing applications on the web.
keyFeatures: React-based timeline: You use familiar React components and state to build video timelines.
Programmatic video generation: It parameterizes videos to render personalized content dynamically.
Web-tech rendering stack: It leverages HTML, CSS, and WebGL for rendering frames.
Server-side execution: It generates videos on servers or serverless functions.
Interactive browser player: It lets you preview and scrub through videos within the browser during development.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: It is built for React developers and content creators wanting to automate video production. Anyone looking to build custom video-centric applications or generate dynamic media at scale will find it extremely powerful.
